schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 13–15 Léamhthuiscint A (with its note and mark boxes); 16–18 Léamhthuiscint B; 19–23 Prós Ainmnithe (2A: Hurlamaboc, then Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille); 24–25 Prós Roghnach (2B); 26–28 Filíocht Ainmnithe (3A); 29–30 Filíocht Roghnach (3B); 31 modified marking (SMM; 32 is its Paper 1 table). PDF 1–12 belong to Paper 1; 33–36 are blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1–3 cover and instructions, 4–7 the two reading passages, 8–12 literature) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card beside the whole question. “3 mharc + 2 mharc” items (and “An chéad … atá ceart = 3 mharc; an dara … = 2 mharc”) are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; a part whose key prints a 3-mark partial answer allows 0/3/5; other single answers allow 0/5.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 ‐ 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; it is stated on every reading card and applied to none.

Literature: Ceist 2 and Ceist 3 are each a closed choice of A or B, and each section prints two questions, (a) and (b), both required. Every printed question is one 25-mark card with its own 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; inside 2A(b) the prescribed Cáca Milis and An Lasair Choille questions are a card each (different Atlas headings), and inside 2B(b) the optional film and play are one card (one heading, one scheme).
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Léamhthuiscint A 50 and B 50 (ten questions, each (a) 5 + (b) 5), Prós 50 (A or B; (a) 25 + (b) 25), Filíocht 50 (A or B; (a) 25 + (b) 25).

Each reading passage opens with one note, “Má tá dhá phointe eolais i gceist, tá 3 mharc ar an gcéad cheann atá ceart agus 2 mharc ar an dara ceann atá ceart.” (2020 also printed the “Gearrfar pionós i ngeall ar iomarcaíocht” note above Ceist 1; 2019 prints it only after Ceist 5(b)).

The 2019 reading key prints shapes 2020 does not: “= cúis amháin” / “= 2 chúis = 3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc” (A 3(a)), “= an chéad rud” / “= an dara rud” (A 4(a)), and a two-power answer “= 3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc (2 chumhacht anseo)” before the single-power list (A 1(a)). All are lifted as printed.
2A(a) Hurlamaboc prints its five sub-questions with “(5 mharc)” each in the scheme; the paper prints only the question’s (25 marc).

3B(a) (the pre-1850 poem) prints (i) “Dhá phointe eolais = 5 mharc + 4 mharc” and (ii)/(iii) “… = 1 mharc” + “Dhá … = 3 mharc + 3 mharc”; 3B(b) (the modern poem) prints (i) “= 1 mharc” + “Dhá phointe eolais = 4 mharc + 4 mharc”.

The scheme’s text layer stores each page’s boxed heading (“CEIST 1 (A + B) ‐ LÉAMHTHUISCINT ‐ 100 marc”, “B– (50 marc)” …) with the page body; the builder removes those exact strings (each printed once) so no heading lands inside an answer key.
Cáca Milis prints its language note with a closing full stop (“… gnóthaíodh.]”); the other nine literature notes do not.
The 2019 paper and scheme print U+2010 hyphens (t‐am, 0‐4, nua‐aimseartha); they are lifted as printed.
No 2019 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 50 cards are new.
